scope: Repository CSB historical corn candidates for CA/MD plus BARC83; not complete statewide cadastral inventory
confidence_meaning: Experimental estimated correctness conditional on V9 predicted class; US80 Maryland development calibration, NOT independently validated in California
prediction_role: inference, not blind validation; training_overlap records explicitly marked
empty_values: CSV empty means unavailable, never zero; conditional_prediction has unverified annual maize eligibility
source_duplicate_policy: CSB and BARC namespaces preserved; may overlap spatially; do not sum their areas blindly
